ani-sat-1.webp.zh: 卫星视角：阿尼亚克机场的跑道沿库斯科克维姆河展开，航站楼与机坪在跑道一侧，周围是林地与湿地。
ani-sat-1.webp.en: Satellite view: Aniak's runway runs along the Kuskokwim River, with the terminal and apron alongside it and woodland and wetlands around.

ani-chatgpt-01.webp.zh: 卫星图上的机场：一条笔直的跑道沿宽阔河岸铺开，旁边散布着房屋、道路与密林。
ani-chatgpt-01.webp.en: In the satellite view, a straight runway runs beside a wide river, with scattered houses, roads and dense forest alongside.

ani-chatgpt-02.webp.zh: 一架涡桨客机停在白色机坪前，远处是挂着薄雾的青山，近处码头系着一艘驳船。
ani-chatgpt-02.webp.en: A turboprop airliner stands on the apron before low white buildings, forested mountains fading into haze behind and a barge tied at the dock in front.

ani-chatgpt-03.webp.zh: 冬季航拍：积雪覆盖的跑道横在两条冰封河道之间，村庄的屋顶在夕照里泛着暖光。
ani-chatgpt-03.webp.en: A winter aerial shows the snow-covered runway lying between two frozen river channels, the village roofs glowing warm in the low sun.
